name: Incline dumbbell curl

phases.name: curl
phases.cue: Curl up without moving your upper arms

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower slowly to a full stretch

formTips: Set the bench to about 45–60° and lie back with your head and shoulders on the pad
Let your arms hang straight down, palms facing forward
Keep your upper arms still and curl the dumbbells up
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight for a big stretch
commonMistakes: Swinging the elbows forward as the dumbbells rise
Lifting the shoulders or head off the pad
Stopping short of a full stretch at the bottom
Going too heavy and losing control on the way down
